mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment growth signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals emerging economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change <= 0.0%) indicates policy misstep that increases real rate uncertainty, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, elevated housing starts (HOUST > 1200.0) signal overbuilding and economic overheating that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that forces restrictive monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high housing starts (HOUST > 1200.0) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 490000.0) indicate overconsumption in demand-driven expansion, triggering market correction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0%), a sharp unemployment decline exceeding 0.3 percentage points in one month signals accelerating wage pressures that may trigger Fed rate hikes, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In labor market tightness periods, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 1 month.
